message.content: According to the conversation recorded on 20260905, WolfgangSchulz expresses feelings of being under a lot of pressure related to his new software project. Specifically, he states, "This new software project is really pushing me to my limits. I feel like I’m constantly in a pressure cooker. 😩" LiHua reassures him by saying, "Just remember, this pressure won’t last forever. You're super talented, and I believe in you! Just take it one step at a time. 💪✨." This indicates that Wolfgang feels overwhelmed by the demands of his work project, likening it to being in a constant state of pressure, much like being in a pressure cooker.
